messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: elevated 5xx/timeout rate on gateway.prod (region: us-west-2). P95 latency spikes, retries amplified. Impact: some requests returning 502/503 and timeouts to clients. Correlation pattern: coro-*/cid-* seen in logs. Pager: @oncall. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/gateway/errors (ops runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/gateway-timeouts)

ops-bot: Automated mitigation attempt: scaled gateway frontends by +2, disabled non-critical retry middleware for 6m. No change observed.

Jane M.: I'm on it. grabbing traces. Can someone paste a few example correlation ids? need to pull full request logs.

Mike K.: saw same. quick snapshot from ingress logs:
```
2026-09-14T14:02:12Z INFO request_id=cid-8a2f coro=abc123 route=/v1/generate upstream=runtime-2 status=502 latency_ms=3400
2026-09-14T14:02:13Z INFO request_id=cid-8b3c coro=abc124 route=/v1/chat upstream=runtime-4 status=504 latency_ms=6001
2026-09-14T14:03:05Z INFO request_id=cid-8d9e coro=abc125 route=/v1/embed upstream=model-q status=502 latency_ms=1200
```
Those three all show upstream 5xx.

Sarah L.: adding hypothesis bucket: 1) upstream runtime overload causing 502/timeout 2) retry amplification between gateway and runtime (double retries) 3) client-side long-running requests saturating connections 4) load-balancer misrouting.

Leo R.: Extracted traces for `cid-8b3c` and `cid-8a2f` to /logs/incidents/2081122334/trace-bundle.tar.gz (s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2081122334/). Links: https://s3.redwood/inc/2081122334/trace-bundle.tar.gz

Nisha P.: Quick correlation: runtime metrics show CPU spikes on runtime-4 at 13:59-14:05, OOM killer not observed. KV cache miss rate increased by ~30% around 14:00. Could be hot keys causing long tails.

Jane M.: Good find. Can we grep for repeat same-origin requests from same CID? If KV cache misses line up with increased token lengths it may explain.

Mike K.: Running a quick query on request logs by coro id series -> looks like a burst of similar prompt prefixes from a small customer tenant `acct-47`. Multiple near-identical requests arriving in <1s windows. Example: coro=abc12[3-7] all correlate to acct-47.

ops-bot: Note: customer-impacting: 14% of requests from acct-47 failed between 13:58-14:07. Customer CS pinged.

Sarah L.: Adding another hypothesis: tenant-level burst causing queueing/backpressure at runtime, combined with aggressive gateway retries causing cascading 5xx. If gateway retries to runtime that's already queued it amplifies failures.

Jane M.: For live mitigation: 1) throttle acct-47 at edge (apply rate-limit rule) 2) temporarily reduce gateway retry attempts to 1 3) add route fallback to smaller model variant for heavy requests 4) continue scaling runtime pool. I'll apply 1 and 2 now.

Jane M.: (applied) edge rate-limit rule id rl-2081122334 -> acct-47 limited to 5rps. gateway retry config rolled from 3 -> 1.

Mike K.: seeing immediate drop in retry volume. metrics: retry-rate down 72% in 30s. latency p95 starting to fall.

IncidentBot: ACTIONS: mitigation applied by Jane M. /monitoring until stable. Please update thread with timeline + artifacts for RCA.

Leo R.: Timeline so far:
- 13:57 initial spike in runtime-4 CPU and KV miss surge
- 13:58 first client-side burst from acct-47
- 13:59 gateway started retrying (3 attempts default) -> increased load to runtime pool
- 14:01 ingress 502/504 spike observed
- 14:04 ops scale +2 attempted (no immediate effect)
- 14:06 edge throttle + retry reduction applied -> metrics improving

Sarah L.: I'm pasting a snippet from runtime logs showing retry receipts and backpressure: 
```
[2026-09-14T14:00:59Z] runtime-4 INFO incoming_request request_id=cid-8b3c from=gateway-2 retries_seen=2 queue_len=18 processing_ms=2500
[2026-09-14T14:01:05Z] runtime-4 WARN request_dropped request_id=cid-8b3c reason=queue_timeout
```

Nisha P.: Suggest we also check ALB connection limits and socket exhaustion on runtime proxies. I've opened a ticket to capture `ss -s` and fd counts on runtime-4.

Jane M.: For RCA notes: primary trigger was high-volume tenant burst causing KV cache miss spike. Secondary: aggressive gateway retry policy amplified load leading to queue timeouts on runtime nodes. Tertiary: autoscaling reacted but too slow relative to the burst.

Mike K.: Who owns follow-ups: 1) telemetry/alerts adjust (Sarah) 2) gateway retry policy defaults + canary (Jane) 3) autoscale responsiveness + warm pools (Leo) 4) tenant-usage throttling docs + quota enforcement (Nisha) 5) customer outreach (CS)

Sarah L.: I'll own telemetry tweaks. Propose alert: correlate KV miss spikes + inbound retry rate to trigger earlier page.

Leo R.: I'll schedule a postmortem doc and add timeline + raw logs link. I'll also include sample correlation IDs and grep queries we used.

Jane M.: Assigning investigation ticket INF-208112 to do deep log analysis and KV hotspot root cause. Adding owners as above.

IncidentBot: Incident status -> mitigated (edge throttle + retry reduction). Please file RCA within 48h and tag with incident:2081122334.

Mike K.: quick note for RCA: capture exact gateway config used (we rolled from 3->1 retries) and snapshot of autoscaler events. Also include sample fluentd filters used for tracing.

Nisha P.: Leaving dump of quick grep commands we used: 
```bash
# find traces for account
grep -R "acct-47" /var/log/gateway/* | awk '{print $1,$2,$3}' > acct-47-ids.txt
# fetch runtime logs for ids
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2081122334/ . --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*cid-8b3c*'
```

Jane M.: Thanks team. I'll keep this thread updated with the RCA doc link once created. If anyone adds more artifacts drop them here.

Sarah L.: FYI CS confirmed customer impact to acct-47; they've been notified of mitigation.

Leo R.: Closing live coordination. Moving to post-incident RCA channel when doc ready.

ops-bot: Reminder: add follow-up items to the incident tracker and set severity to S2 for accounting.

Jane M.: done. tagging owners in tracker and setting due dates"
